title: Background process completion

turns.prompt: Open item: start a background health check 'sleep 3 && echo healthy' and keep it as an open item until it finishes. Also our objective is to confirm the service is healthy.

script.content: Started the background health check. Open item: service health unconfirmed until the check completes. Objective: confirm service health.

turns.prompt: Filler while the check runs: list two health endpoints worth probing.
Once the background check reports back, does the service look healthy, and what open item does that close?

script.content: The check output decides health; a completed healthy probe closes the open service-health item.

extractionRecords.text: Confirm the service is healthy via the background health check.
